sarah.name: Sarah Johnson
sarah.quote: This platform transformed my English skills in just 3 months. The interactive lessons and AI feedback made learning fun and effective.

miguel.name: Miguel Rodriguez
miguel.quote: The pronunciation coaching feature helped me gain confidence in speaking English. I can now actively participate in class discussions.

aisha.name: Aisha Patel
aisha.quote: The personalized learning path kept me motivated. I love how the system adapts to my schedule and learning preferences.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our platform and learning process
faq.answer1: Our platform is suitable for learners of all levels, from absolute beginners to advanced speakers looking to refine their skills.
faq.answer2: You can start seeing improvement in your speaking confidence within the first few weeks, with significant progress typically after 2-3 months of consistent practice.
faq.answer3: Yes, our mobile app allows you to learn on the go with full synchronization across all your devices.
faq.answer4: We offer various subscription plans, including monthly, quarterly, and annual options. You can also try our free trial to explore the platform.
faq.answer5: Absolutely! Our AI tutor provides personalized feedback on your pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary in real-time.
faq.answer6: Our curriculum covers business English, academic English, conversational skills, and test preparation (IELTS, TOEFL, etc.).
faq.answer7: Yes, you can pause your subscription at any time and resume when you're ready to continue learning.
faq.answer8: We provide 24/7 customer support via chat, email, and video calls with our learning specialists.
faq.answer9: Yes, you'll receive a certificate of completion for each course and level you successfully finish.
faq.answer10: Our platform uses advanced speech recognition and natural language processing technology to provide accurate, personalized feedback on your progress.
